prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Open a count session and record the reason. Restrict sales/receipts at the warehouse while counting.

count.title: Record counts
count.description: Scan barcodes or select product + batch, enter actual quantities. Submit in batches.

reconcile.title: Reconcile variances
reconcile.description: Review Sys · Count · Var. Fix GRN/POS/transfers first if source documents are wrong.

approve.title: Approve & update stock
approve.description: Approver confirms — system adjusts stock by batch and locks the session.

approveChecklist.0: Large variances reconciled with documents (GRN, sales, transfers) — fix source transactions if needed
approveChecklist.1: Remaining variances reflect actual counts (by batch)
approveChecklist.2: Approver is different from counter (when possible) and session reason is recorded
